name: review-gate
description: Reviews a branch before its pull request with Claude Code's /code-review, at a level the change's risk picks, keeps every finding until it is fixed or dismissed with a reason, and opens and merges the pull request only for the reviewed commit.

level.title: Review level
level.description: The /code-review level each round runs at. auto picks by the risk a classifier reads from the change: medium for low, high for medium, xhigh for high. A round over new commits alone runs at most at high, whatever this option says, unless the review call or /review-gate names its level.

riskModel.title: Risk model
riskModel.description: The model that judges a change's risk before each round. inherit uses the session's model.
